## Built for what you're shipping

### Web Apps

Host the web apps you and your agents build, with Postgres and storage.

### APIs

Run the APIs behind your product on VMs in 18 regions, close to your users.

### Coding Agent Workspaces

Give your engineering team access to Claude Code and Codex in the cloud.

### Agent Fleets

Run untrusted code, evals, and RL rollouts in parallel. Checkpoint what works, throw away the rest.

### Agent Products

Get a computer for every customer’s agent. It sleeps (at zero compute cost) until you wake it on request.

## Use the tech you love

Deploy apps and agents built with your favorite framework. Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`. No Dockerfile? No problem: we'll generate one for most popular frameworks, including Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, .NET and more.


[Learn more](https://fly.io/speedrun/)

## Secure by design

The answers your security review will ask for (but way more than they want to know. We can't help it, we nerd out about this stuff.)


[Read the security overview](https://fly.io/security/)

- ### Hardware isolation, always


Every computer is its own Firecracker microVM. No shared kernel, and no faster mode that skips it.

- ### Credentials stay out


Connectors broker logins and API keys at the gateway. The agent uses them without ever holding them.

- ### Egress you control


Lock any computer to an allowlist of hosts. Private networking between everything else by default.

- ### Compliance, built in


SOC 2 Type II. HIPAA with a pre-signed BAA. SSO and support SLAs for enterprise teams.
